# queueengine

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/framework/internal/app/queueengine"
```

Package queueengine is what framework/app/queue plugs into kit: the brokers the framework's consumers' queues run on — the SDK's queue in memory, in the data directory and over SQL, a mailer's outbox on a database sealed in front of the SQL one —, the consumer that delivers them, and the migration of a queue's table (ADR 0179 §1, step 4). The framework's core imports none of the SDK's queue: it reaches it through plug, and a product that declares no topic, no subscription, no watch, no queued command and no outbox on a database links none of it.

Package queueengine — the compile-time proof that the brokers are the framework's.

```go
func BrokerOf(b plug.Broker) (queue.Broker, bool)
```

BrokerOf is the SDK's broker behind b, a queue this package opened: what a mailer's spool keeps its outbox in on a database (ADR 0179 step 6) — the sealed outbox, behind a test's wrapper when it set one —; false for a queue it did not open.
